title: EEVblog #138 - Top 5 Tips for Graduate Engineers

mentions.context_snippet: He's a graduate electronics design engineer and he's scored himself a good job

mentions.context_snippet: at a big aerospace company

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: take a specification, design it, build it, troubleshoot it, test it, commission it

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones

mentions.context_snippet: my top five career and life experience tips for graduate engineers

mentions.context_snippet: That can often be what big engineering companies are like

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: No electronics engineering, no design job is going to be 100% fun

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: maybe a career path into management

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: you've got to fight for the real cool job

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: if your boss is a design engineer, he's going to snap it up

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: work your ass off for 6 months, 12 months, whatever, on a project, only to have it be shit-canned

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: Always work on your own projects in your own time

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: some of the most satisfying projects you work on might be your own

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: You won't be able to make your own decisions

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: If the pay is good, the conditions are good, the people are good

mentions.context_snippet: That means you get to do the entire product design from start to finish

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: the concept, the spec, the design, the board layout, the software, firmware

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: If anything fails, you're the one that's responsible for it

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: these contract design engineering companies

mentions.context_snippet: These big companies will hire these smaller contract firms to design the product

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: those jobs can involve really tight deadlines

mentions.context_snippet: Move around a lot. Change jobs. Don't be afraid to have five jobs in ten years

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: get a job that pays for your travel and sends you around the world

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: don't be afraid to take that risky job at the start-up

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: Networking is a huge thing. It's not just what jobs are advertised out there

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: when I got my first professional job at 17, I started saving money

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: If you've got money behind you that you've saved up, then you don't have to put up with a bad manager

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: Start designing your own products. Start your own business
